liability.title: 假阳率／假阴率责任兜底（结构演示）
liability.disclaimer: 结构演示，不是法律意见：只提示合同里要有哪几块，措辞须由双方法务确认。不替代安全评价、法定安全设施或人工巡检。
liability.disclaimer_en: Structure demo, not legal advice: it only shows which pieces a contract needs; wording must be confirmed by both sides' counsel. Does not replace safety assessments, statutory safety systems or manual patrols.

items.label: 误报率口径与统计周期
items.missing: 未约定：不对外报误报率
items.missing_en: Not agreed: no false-alarm figures externally

items.label: 漏报责任归属
items.ok: 已约定：AI 辅助，不替代人工巡检／法定安全设施
items.ok_en: Agreed: AI assists, does not replace patrols / statutory systems

items.label: 联动物理动作
items.ok: 不联动，或联动前有人工确认
items.ok_en: No linkage, or human confirmation before linkage
items.missing: 联动但无人工确认：拒单
items.missing_en: Linked with no human confirmation: reject

rules.message: 单帧检出就直接触发高阶告警 → 拒单。先加时序连续帧校验（如连续 ≥3~5 秒）。
rules.message_en: A single-frame detection fires a high-level alarm directly → reject. Add a temporal multi-frame check first (e.g. sustained ≥3–5 s).

rules.message: 烟火告警没有红外／热成像测温差复核 → 暂缓承诺烟火误报指标。
rules.message_en: Fire/smoke alarms have no infrared / thermal temperature-difference recheck → hold any fire false-alarm figures.

rules.message: 烟火告警要联动声光／喷淋，却没过「连续帧 + 测温差」两道复核 → 拒单。
rules.message_en: Fire alarms will drive beacons / sprinklers but have not passed both the multi-frame and temperature-difference checks → reject.

rules.message: 现场有动火作业，电焊区却不支持报备期内的时间-空间动态掩模 → 弧光会被当火灾，拒单。
rules.message_en: There is hot work on site, but welding zones cannot be masked by time and area during the permit window → arc flashes will read as fire; reject.

rules.message: 反光衣／安全帽识别没绑定骨骼关键点或头肩-躯干关联 → 托盘、缠绕膜、防雨布会被当违规人员，拒单。
rules.message_en: Vest / helmet recognition is not tied to body keypoints or head-shoulder-torso association → pallets, stretch film and tarps will be flagged as violators; reject.

rules.message: 围栏按检测框中心点／外接矩形相交判入侵 → 吊臂、货车阴影会被当闯入，拒单。改为只认接地点。
rules.message_en: The fence triggers on box centre / bounding-box overlap → crane booms and truck shadows will count as intrusions; reject. Trigger on ground-contact points only.

rules.message: 围栏没有阴影剔除 → 暂缓承诺围栏误报指标。
rules.message_en: The fence has no shadow removal → hold any fence false-alarm figures.

rules.message: 静态围栏没绑定场景锚点、不做开机／预置位后的基准比对 → 球机一碰歪围栏就漂移，拒单。
rules.message_en: Static fences are not bound to scene anchors and are not re-checked against the reference image at power-up / preset → one bumped camera shifts the fence; reject.

rules.message: 没有视频流质量自检（盲拍、遮挡、偏色、过曝、脏污、卡死）→ 镜头被糊住也报「安全」，拒单。
rules.message_en: No video-stream quality probe (blank, blocked, colour cast, overexposed, dirty lens, frozen) → a blinded camera still reports "safe"; reject.

rules.message: 把公开数据集指标当现场承诺 → 拒单。公开数据集指标不代表现场。
rules.message_en: A public-dataset metric is being offered as an on-site promise → reject. Public-dataset numbers do not represent the site.

rules.message: 误报率口径和统计周期未书面约定 → 暂缓对外报任何误报率数字。
rules.message_en: The false-alarm definition and counting period are not agreed in writing → hold any false-alarm figures.

rules.message: 已写了指标话术，但没有书面口径和统计周期 → 这段话不进方案和报价。
rules.message_en: A metric claim has been drafted with no written definition or counting period → keep it out of the proposal and the quote.

rules.message: 漏报责任归属未约定 → 暂缓签交付，先写明 AI 是辅助，不替代人工巡检和法定安全设施。
rules.message_en: Liability for missed alarms is not agreed → hold signing; first state in writing that AI assists and does not replace manual patrols or statutory safety systems.

rules.message: 客户要求「零漏报」承诺 → 拒单。
rules.message_en: The customer wants a "zero missed alarms" promise → reject.

rules.message: 告警联动声光／喷淋／停机，却没有人工确认环节 → 拒单。
rules.message_en: Alarms drive beacons / sprinklers / shutdowns with no human confirmation step → reject.

rules.message: 还没勾本单包含哪类告警 → 先确认范围，再按类型过边界。
rules.message_en: No alarm type has been selected for this deal → confirm the scope first, then check each type's boundaries.

rules.message: 所选告警类型的技术与工程边界齐全，责任口径已书面约定 → 可在约定口径内报价，对外写「AI 辅助告警」。
rules.message_en: Technical and engineering boundaries for the selected alarm types are in place and liability is agreed in writing → OK to quote within the agreed definitions, described as "AI-assisted alerting".

scope.label: 告警范围
scope.action: 和安全科确认本单做哪几类：烟火、穿戴、电子围栏。
scope.action_en: Confirm with the safety department which types this deal covers: fire/smoke, PPE, electronic fence.

fireRecheck.label: 烟火双复核
fireRecheck.action: 单帧不直触高阶告警：加连续帧时序校验（如 ≥3~5 秒）+ 红外／热成像测温差复核。
fireRecheck.action_en: No single-frame high-level alarms: add a temporal multi-frame check (e.g. ≥3–5 s) plus an infrared / thermal temperature-difference recheck.

hotWorkMask.label: 动火作业动态掩模
hotWorkMask.action: 接入动火作业报备，报备期内对电焊区做时间-空间动态屏蔽。
hotWorkMask.action_en: Hook into hot-work permits and mask welding zones by time and area during the permit window.

pose.label: 人形骨架绑定
pose.action: 穿戴识别绑定骨骼关键点或头肩-躯干关联置信度；没有有效人形主干，不报穿戴告警。
pose.action_en: Tie PPE recognition to body keypoints or head-shoulder-torso confidence; no valid body skeleton, no PPE alarm.

fenceGeometry.label: 接地点判定 + 阴影剔除
fenceGeometry.action: 入侵只认脚底关键点／车轮着地点落入围栏多边形，并加阴影剔除。
fenceGeometry.action_en: Count an intrusion only when a foot keypoint / wheel contact point lands inside the fence polygon, and add shadow removal.

anchor.label: 场景锚点防漂移
anchor.action: 围栏绑定固定钢柱、地面标志等几何锚点；开机／预置位到位后比对基准图像单应性矩阵，超公差就告警、冻结围栏、人工重核。
anchor.action_en: Bind fences to fixed anchors (steel columns, floor markings); after power-up / preset, compare against the reference image homography; beyond tolerance, alarm, freeze the fence and re-verify by hand.

videoProbe.label: 视频质量自检
videoProbe.action: 上视频流质量探针；锐度或直方图熵低于阈值超过设定时长，优先报「视觉通道失活」。
videoProbe.action_en: Add a stream-quality probe; when sharpness or histogram entropy stays below threshold past a set time, raise "vision channel down" first.

fpDefinition.label: 误报率书面口径
fpDefinition.action: 书面约定误报率怎么计、统计周期多长，只用本现场数据算，不拿公开数据集指标。
fpDefinition.action_en: Agree in writing how false alarms are counted and over what period, using this site's data only — never public-dataset metrics.

missLiability.label: 漏报责任归属
missLiability.action: 书面写明 AI 是辅助，不替代人工巡检和法定安全设施；不接受「零漏报」条款。
missLiability.action_en: State in writing that AI assists and does not replace manual patrols or statutory safety systems; do not accept a "zero missed alarms" clause.

humanConfirm.label: 联动人工确认
humanConfirm.action: 联动声光／喷淋／停机前加人工确认环节，或更严格的多重复核。
humanConfirm.action_en: Put a human confirmation step — or stricter multi-check — before driving beacons / sprinklers / shutdowns.
